sentences.en: I wish to express my deep appreciation for your kindness.
sentences.zh: 1. 我想表达我对你的善意的深深感激。

sentences.en: May I present this to you in token of my appreciation?
sentences.zh: 2. 可以把这作为我的谢意赠给你吗？

sentences.en: The yen's appreciation accelerated the decline of that company.
sentences.zh: 3. 日元的升值加速了那家公司的衰落。

senses.zh: 欣赏,鉴赏,赏识 - 评定；判断；鉴定 - (尤指土地或财产的)增值 - 感激；感谢 - (尤指赞赏性的)评论文字
